headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals continued their winning streak with an 8-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, led by Jordan Walker's home run and three RBIs. In other news, the Houston Astros shut out the Chicago Cubs 3-0, with Christian Walker contributing three hits, including two home runs, and three RBIs.

Several teams suffered injuries, including the Texas Rangers, who placed Cole Winn on the 15-day injured list due to right arm fatigue. The Washington Nationals also placed Jake Irvin on the 15-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. The Chicago Cubs, Detroit Tigers, Tampa Bay Rays, Arizona Diamondbacks, and Chicago White Sox each had players placed on the injured list as well.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, while the Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Cardinals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged the St. Louis Cardinals 7-6, securing a crucial win. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Kai-Wei Teng pitching 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. Christian Walker led the Astros' offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Patrick Corbin earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Blue Jays 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays in their recent matchup. Impact players for the Pirates included Spencer Horwitz, Oneil Cruz, and Esmerlyn Valdez, while Dylan Cease led the way on the mound.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dropped a 3-5 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, marking a tough loss for the team. Impact players on the day included Matt Vierling and Brant Hurter for the Tigers, while Gunnar Henderson and Colton Cowser led the Orioles' offense.

top_news.title: **Cole Winn Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers right-handed pitcher Cole Winn has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right arm fatigue.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
